request: give the screen a card with a big number for how many reading entries there are this week and the caption "entries this week" above the "entries last week" stat
program_before:
app "Electricity" bolt orange
table reading units num 0..99999 unit "units", note text?
table bill month_name text, amount money
setting rate money = 42 "Price per unit"
setting limit num = 300 "Units I want to stay under"
let used = last(reading.units) - first(reading.units month)
let est = used * rate
topbar reading, "Add reading"
statcard max(used, 0), "units used this month, limit" limit, limit
row gap 2
  statcard round(est), "estimated bill so far"
  statcard max(round(used / max(monthday(today), 1) * 10) / 10, 0), "units per day"
if used > limit
  "You are over your limit. Switch off the standby devices." color warn bold
section "Meter readings", "last 30 days"
  trend reading last 30 days, it.units
section "Projection", "if you keep this pace"
  round(max(used, 0) / max(monthday(today), 1) * monthdays(today)) big
  "units by the end of the month" faint
section "Paid bills", "last 6"
  bars bill top 6, it.amount, it.month_name
section "Add a bill"
  form bill, "Save bill"
section "Cost per unit", "from paid bills"
  round(sum(bill.amount) / max(count(bill), 1)) big
  "average bill" faint
section "Readings"
  list reading by day, "No readings yet. Read the meter on the first of each month."
row gap 2
  statcard count(reading prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(reading) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(reading year) faint
  "Last one" since(reading) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(reading where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(reading on it), 2
section "The numbers", "all time"
  "Average" round(avg(reading.units) * 10) / 10 "units" big
  "Highest" max(reading.units) "units" faint
  "Lowest" min(reading.units) "units" faint

request: right, throw in a big number for the total litres from milk (only where shift is Evening) this week with the caption "L evening" at the end of the row
program_before:
app "Dairy Log" milk blue
table milk cow pick Gauri|Laali|Moti|Kali|Chandni = Gauri, litres num 1..40 = 8 unit "L", shift pick Morning|Evening = Morning
setting price money = 140 "Price per litre"
setting goal num = 60 "Daily herd goal (L)"
state sh pick Morning|Evening = Morning
let today_l = sum(milk.litres today)
topbar milk, "Add milking"
statcard today_l, "litres today of" goal, goal
row gap 2
  stat today_l * price, "earned today"
  stat sum(milk.litres week) * price, "earned this week"
section "Shift view"
  choice sh
  each options milk.cow as c
    row gap 2
      c bold grow
      sum(milk.litres today where cow = c and shift = sh) "L" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 90
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(milk.litres today where cow = c and shift = sh) / 12, 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Last 7 days", "average" round(sum(milk.litres last 7 days) / 7) "L a day"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(milk.litres on it), goal
section "Best cows this month", "litres"
  share milk month by cow, sum(it.litres), it.key
list milk today by day, "No milking logged today. Add the morning shift first."
section "Evening against morning", "this week"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(milk.litres week where shift = Morning), "L morning"
section "Litres per day", "last 14 days"
  trend days last 14 days, sum(milk.litres on it)
section "Best day this month", "litres"
  stat max(days month, sum(milk.litres on it)), "L in one day"
section "Month income", "at the price per litre"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(milk.litres month) * price, "earned"
    stat round(sum(milk.litres month) / max(count(days month, count(milk on it) > 0), 1)), "L a day"
section "Milk per shift", "this week"
  each options milk.shift as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(milk.litres week where shift = v) "L" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(milk.litres week where shift = v) / max(sum(milk.litres week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if today_l >= goal
  "Daily goal reached." color good bold

app "Print Works" tag red

  stat count(job where stage != Delivered), "open jobs"

app "Pipeline" target red dark
table lead company text, stage pick New|Contacted|Proposal|Won|Lost = New, value money, next date?

  each lead where next <= today and stage != Won and stage != Lost as l empty "No follow-ups due."

  share lead by stage, count(it), it.key

request: Could you show a stat showing the lowest rate in price (only where crop is c), captioned "lowest" right after the highest stat?
program_before:
app "Mandi Rates" chart yellow
table price crop pick Wheat|Rice|Cotton|Maize|Sugarcane = Wheat, rate money, town text?
setting mine money = 4000 "My selling price"
state c pick Wheat|Rice|Cotton|Maize|Sugarcane = Wheat
topbar price, "Add rate"
choice c
statcard last(price.rate where crop = c), "latest rate for" c "against my" mine, mine
if last(price.rate where crop = c) >= mine
  "The market is at or above your price. Time to sell." color good bold
else
  "Below your selling price. Wait a little." color warn bold
row gap 2
  stat max(price.rate where crop = c), "highest"
  stat round(avg(price.rate where crop = c)), "average"
section "Price trend", "last 30 days"
  trend price last 30 days where crop = c sort at, it.rate
section "Rates logged", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(price on it where crop = c)
section "Latest rate per crop"
  each options price.crop as k
    row gap 2
      k bold grow
      last(price.rate where crop = k) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 70
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(last(price.rate where crop = k) / max(mine * 1.5, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "History", c
  each price where crop = c top 5 as p empty "No rates logged for this crop. Add the first one."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      stack grow gap 0
        p.rate bold
        p.town faint
      p.at faint
section "Price against mine", "latest rate per crop"
  each options price.crop as k
    row gap 2
      k bold grow
      if(last(price.rate where crop = k) >= mine, "Sell", "Wait") color if(last(price.rate where crop = k) >= mine, good, warn)
section "Towns", "where rates came from"
  each price where crop = c top 3 as p
    row gap 2
      p.town bold grow
      p.rate faint

program_before:
app "Ride Profit" bike ink dark
table ride platform pick Bykea|Careem|Indrive|Cash = Cash, fare money, km num 1..100 = 8 unit "km", tip money = 0
table expense kind pick Fuel|Repair|Phone|Food = Fuel, amount money
setting target money = 35000 "Weekly profit goal"
let income = sum(ride.fare week) + sum(ride.tip week)

topbar ride, "Add ride"
statcard profit, "profit this week of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat income, "earned"
  stat round(profit / max(sum(ride.km week), 1)), "profit per km"

section "Rides per platform"
  each options ride.platform as p
    row gap 2
      p bold grow
      count(ride week where platform = p) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(ride week where platform = p) / max(count(ride week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Spending", "this month"
  share expense month by kind, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Add an expense"
  form expense, "Save expense"
section "Today's rides", plural(count(ride today), "ride")
  each ride today as r empty "No rides yet today. Log the first fare."
    row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
      stack grow gap 0
        r.platform bold
        r.km "km" faint
      r.fare + r.tip bold

  "Weekly goal reached." color good bold

app "Team Load" users ocean
table person name text, hours num 4..60 = 40 unit "h"
table plan person ref person, task text, hours num 1..40 = 8 unit "h"
setting buffer num = 10 "Keep free (percent)"
let cap = sum(person.hours) * (100 - buffer) / 100
let planned = sum(plan.hours week)
topbar person, "Add person"
goal planned, cap, "hours planned of usable capacity", "h"
row gap 2
  stat round(cap - planned), "usable hours left"
  stat count(plan week), "tasks planned"
section "Load per person", "this week"
  each person sort name as p empty "No people yet. Add your team with Add person."
    stack card gap 1 tap edit p swipe remove p
      row
        p.name bold grow
        sum(p.plan.hours week) "of" p.hours "h" faint color if(sum(p.plan.hours week) > p.hours, bad, muted)
      draw 100, 4
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(p.plan.hours week) / max(p.hours, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill if(sum(p.plan.hours week) > p.hours, bad, accent) radius 2
section "Hours by person", "planned"
  share person, sum(it.plan.hours week), it.name
section "Planned per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(plan.hours on it)
section "Plan a task"
  form plan, "Save task"
section "Latest tasks"
  list plan top 5, "No tasks planned yet."
section "Who is free", "most hours left first"
  each person sort sum(it.plan.hours week) - it.hours top 3 as p
    row gap 2
      p.name bold grow
      p.hours - sum(p.plan.hours week) "h free" faint
if planned > cap
  "The team is overloaded this week. Move a task." color bad bold

  each person top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        "Weekly capacity" faint
      x.hours "h" bold

request: Real quick, please add a stat with the caption "churned" that shows the number of sub entries (only where status is Churned) after the "on trial" box, for my own use
program_before:
app "MRR" chart blue dark
table sub customer text, plan pick Starter|Pro|Team = Starter, mrr money, status pick Active|Trial|Churned = Trial
setting target money = 500000 "MRR target"
let live = sum(sub.mrr where status = Active)
screen overview "Overview" chart
  statcard live, "MRR of" target, target
  row gap 2
    stat count(sub where status = Active), "paying customers"
    stat count(sub where status = Trial), "on trial"
  section "MRR by plan", "active customers"
    share sub where status = Active by plan, sum(it.mrr), it.key
  section "New customers", "last 14 days"
    daybars last 14 days, count(sub on it)
  section "Churn", "share of all customers"
    goal count(sub where status = Churned), max(count(sub), 1), "customers lost", "lost"
  section "Average revenue", "per paying customer"
    stat round(avg(sub.mrr where status = Active)), "ARPU"
screen customers "Customers" users
  topbar sub, "Add customer"
  each sub sort at desc as s empty "No customers yet. Add your first trial."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.customer bold
        s.plan s.mrr faint
      if s.status = Trial
        button "Convert" tap set s.status = Active
      if s.status = Active
        button "Cancel" tap set s.status = Churned
screen team "Targets" target
  goal live, target, "of the MRR target"
  section "Gap", "to the target"
    row gap 2
      stat max(target - live, 0), "MRR still to find"
      stat round(max(target - live, 0) / max(avg(sub.mrr where status = Active), 1)), "customers needed"
  section "Plans"
    each options sub.plan as p
      row gap 2
        p bold grow
        count(sub where plan = p and status = Active) "active" faint

program_before:
app "Times tables" calc yellow
table attempt q text, right bool
setting level num = 9 "Largest number"
state a num = 6
state b num = 7
state answer num = 0
let right_today = count(attempt today where right = yes)
topbar attempt, "Add by hand"
row gap 2
  statcard right_today, "right today"
  statcard count(attempt today where right = no), "to practise again"
section "Question"
  join(a, " x ", b) huge
  field answer "Your answer"
  row gap 1
    button "Check" fill accent tap add attempt q = join(a, " x ", b), right = if(answer = a * b, yes, no) then set a = random(level) then set b = random(level) then set answer = 0
    button "Skip" tap set a = random(level) then set b = random(level)
section "Right per day", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, count(attempt on it where right = yes)
section "Accuracy", "last 7 days"
  round(count(attempt last 7 days where right = yes) * 100 / max(count(attempt last 7 days), 1)) "% right" big
  goal count(attempt last 7 days where right = yes), max(count(attempt last 7 days), 1), "right answers", ""
section "Practice days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(attempt on it), 10
section "Questions to repeat"
  each attempt where right = no top 5 as t empty "No wrong answers lately. Great work."
    row gap 2
      t.q grow
      "again" faint
section "Streak"
  streak(attempt) "days of practice" big
section "Attempts"
  list attempt today, "No attempts today. Type an answer and tap Check."
row gap 2
  statcard count(attempt prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(attempt) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(attempt year) faint
  "Last one" since(attempt) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(attempt where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(attempt on it), 2

program_before:
app "Pedal Club" bike green
table ride rider pick Ahmed|Zara|Imran|Mina|Raza = Ahmed, km num 1..300 = 20 unit "km", mins num 5..900 = 60 unit "min"
setting goal num = 800 "Club goal this month (km)"
let total = sum(ride.km month)
topbar ride, "Log ride"
statcard total, "km this month of" goal, goal
row gap 2
  stat count(ride month), "rides"
  stat round(sum(ride.km month) * 60 / max(sum(ride.mins month), 1)), "average km/h"
section "Leaderboard", "km this month"
  share ride month by rider, sum(it.km), it.key
section "Distance per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(ride.km on it)

  daygrid last 35 days, count(ride on it), 3
section "Rides per rider", "all time"
  bars ride by rider, count(it), it.key
section "Latest rides"
  each ride top 4 as r empty "No rides yet. Log the first ride."

      stack grow gap 0
        r.rider bold
        r.mins "min" faint
      r.km "km" bold
if total >= goal
  "Club goal reached this month." color good bold
section "Km per rider", "this month"
  each options ride.rider as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(ride.km month where rider = v) "km" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(ride.km month where rider = v) / max(goal / 3, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each ride top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.rider bold
        x.at faint
      x.km "km" bold

request: small request: put a card with a big number for how many shift entries there are last week and the caption "entries last week" on the screen below the "entries this week" number, for my own use
program_before:
app "Volunteering" users orange
table shift hours num 0.5..24 unit "h", cause pick Food_bank|School|Mosque|Hospital|Clean_up|Other = Food_bank, place text?
setting yearly_goal num = 100 "Hours per year"
let hrs = sum(shift.hours year)
topbar shift, "Log shift"
statcard round(hrs * 10) / 10, "hours this year, goal" yearly_goal, yearly_goal
row gap 2
  statcard count(shift year), "shifts this year"
  statcard round(avg(shift.hours) * 10) / 10, "hours per shift"
section "By cause", "this year"
  share shift year by cause, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Hours per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, round(sum(shift.hours month of addmonths(today, it - 6))), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "Where you help"
  share shift where place != "" by place, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Shift days", "last 10 weeks"
  heat last 70 days, count(shift on it), 1
section "On pace", "for the year"
  round(hrs / max(month(today), 1) * 12) big
  "hours by December at this pace" faint
section "Longest shift"
  max(shift.hours) "h" big
  "Last shift" since(shift) "days ago" faint
section "All shifts"
  list shift by day, "No shifts yet. Log the hours you gave this week."
row gap 2
  statcard count(shift week), "entries this week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(shift) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(shift year) faint
  "Last one" since(shift) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(shift where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(shift on it), 2

request: next, show me a goal bar for how many student entries there are against the capacity with the caption "seats filled", with the unit "students" right before the "Not paid yet" card when you can
program_before:
app "Academy Fees" school blue
table student name text, class pick Grade_6|Grade_7|Grade_8|Matric = Grade_6
table fee student ref student, amount money = 3500
setting capacity num = 40 "Seats in the academy"
let paid = count(student, count(it.fee month) > 0)
topbar student, "Add student"
statcard sum(fee.amount month), "collected this month from" paid "of" count(student), count(student) * 3500
section "Not paid yet", "this month"
  if paid = count(student) and paid > 0
    "Everyone has paid this month. Well done." color good bold
  each student sort name as s empty "No students yet. Add the first name with Add student."
    if count(s.fee month) = 0
      row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
        toggle s.fee month
        stack grow gap 0
          s.name bold
          s.class faint
        "Due" color bad
section "Students per class"
  share student by class, count(it), it.key
section "Fees collected", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(fee.amount month of it), monthname(it)
section "Paid this month", count(fee month)
  list fee month, "No fees paid yet this month."
section "Fee collection", "this month"
  goal paid, max(count(student), 1), "students have paid"
section "New students", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, count(student month of it), monthname(it)
section "Class sizes"
  row gap 2
    each options student.class as c
      stat count(student where class = c), c
if count(student) >= capacity
  "The academy is full." color warn bold
section "Paid per class", "this month"
  each options student.class as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(student where class = v and count(fee month) > 0) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2

    row card gap 2

table milestone what text, day date = today
setting born date = 2026-06-01 "Baby's birthday"
let months_old = floor((today - born) / 30)
topbar milestone, "Add milestone"
row gap 2
  statcard months_old, "months old"
section "Diapers", "tap to log one"
  row gap 1
    each options diaper.kind as k
      button k count(diaper today where kind = k) tap add diaper kind = k
  daybars last 7 days, count(diaper on it)
section "Wet or dirty", "last 7 days"
  share diaper last 7 days by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Diaper days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(diaper on it), 8
section "Firsts"
  each milestone sort day desc as m empty "No milestones yet. Add the first smile, the first roll."
    row card gap 2 tap edit m swipe remove m
      stack grow gap 0
        m.what bold
        m.day faint
      "at" floor((m.day - born) / 7) "weeks" faint
section "Average a day", "last 7 days"
  round(count(diaper last 7 days) / 7) big
  "diapers a day, enough wet ones mean enough milk" faint
section "Milestones count"
  count(milestone) big
row gap 2
  statcard count(diaper week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(diaper prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(diaper) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(diaper year) faint
  "Last one" since(diaper) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(diaper where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(diaper on it), 2

app "Helpdesk" phone mint
table ticket subject text, channel pick Email|Chat|Phone|Social = Email, priority pick Low|Normal|Urgent = Normal, status pick New|Working|Solved = New, mins num 1..600 = 15 unit "min"
setting sla num = 30 "Handling target (min)"

program_before:
app "Pet Shop" paw pink
table item name text, kind pick Food|Toys|Cages|Medicine|Fish = Food, qty num 0.. = 10, price money, low num 0.. = 3
table sale item ref item, amount money
setting daily num = 20 "Daily sales goal (items)"
let short = count(item, it.qty <= it.low)
topbar item, "Add item"
goal count(sale today), daily, "items sold today", "items"
row gap 2
  stat count(sale today), "sales today"
  stat short, "running low"
section "Stock", "tap Sell to take one off"
  each item sort kind as i empty "No stock yet. Add your first product with Add item."
    row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
      stack grow gap 0
        i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
        i.kind "-" i.price faint
      i.qty bold
      button "Sell" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1 then add sale item = i, amount = i.price
section "Sales", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(sale.amount on it)
section "Best category", "this month"
  share sale month by item.kind, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Restock", "at or below the low level"
  each item where qty <= low as i empty "Nothing to restock."
    row gap 2
      i.name bold grow
      i.qty "left" faint color warn
section "Stock value", "at selling price"
  stat sum(item, it.qty * it.price), "total"
section "Stock per category", "items on shelf"
  each options item.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(item.qty where kind = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(item.qty where kind = v) / max(sum(item.qty), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each item top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        x.kind faint
      x.qty bold

request: put a stat showing the number of stay entries (only where checkin is today), captioned "arrivals today" on the screen below the unpaid stays stat
program_before:
app "Guest House" home ocean
table room name text, rate money
table stay room ref room, guest text, nights num 1..30 = 1, checkin date = today, paid bool
setting target num = 70 "Occupancy target (percent)"
let occupied(r room) = count(stay where room = r and checkin <= today and checkin + nights > today)
let busy = count(room, occupied(it) > 0)
topbar room, "Add room"
goal busy, max(count(room), 1), "rooms occupied tonight", "rooms"
row gap 2
  stat round(busy * 100 / max(count(room), 1)), "percent occupied, target" target
  stat sum(stay where paid = no, it.nights * it.room.rate), "unpaid stays"
section "Rooms tonight"
  grid 2 gap 1
    each room sort name as r empty "No rooms yet. Add your rooms with Add room."
      stack radius 10 pad 1 gap 0 fill if(occupied(r) > 0, accent, soft) tap edit r
        r.name bold color if(occupied(r) > 0, bg, ink)
        if(occupied(r) > 0, "Occupied", "Free") faint color if(occupied(r) > 0, bg, muted)
section "Check in a guest"
  form stay, "Check in"
section "Arriving soon", "next stays"
  each stay where checkin >= today sort checkin top 4 as s empty "No arrivals coming."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      toggle s.paid
      stack grow gap 0
        s.guest bold
        s.room.name "-" s.nights "nights" faint
      s.checkin faint
section "Income", "last 4 weeks"
  bars days last 4 weeks, sum(stay week of it, it.nights * it.room.rate), monthday(it)
section "Nights by room", "this month"
  share stay month by room.name, sum(it.nights), it.key
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each room top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        "Rate per night" faint
      x.rate bold

table revise subject text, hours num 0.5..10 unit "h" = 1
setting weekly_hours num = 14 "Revision hours per week"
let wk = sum(revise.hours week)
remind "Revision time" at 16:00
topbar exam, "Add exam"
each exam where day >= today sort day top 1 as e empty "No exams ahead. Add your next paper."
  row card gap 3 align center
    stack grow gap 0
      "Next exam" faint
      e.subject head
      e.day faint
    stack gap 0 align center
      e.day - today huge
      "days left" faint
section "Revision this week", "so far" wk "of" weekly_hours "h"
  goal wk, weekly_hours, "hours of revision", "h"
section "Revision per day", "last 7 days"
  daybars last 7 days, sum(revise.hours on it)
section "Hours per subject", "this month"
  share revise month by subject, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Log revision"
  row gap 1
    button "1 hour" tap add revise subject = "General", hours = 1
    button "2 hours" tap add revise subject = "General", hours = 2
  list revise today, "No revision logged today."
section "All exams", "by date"
  each exam sort day as x empty "No exams yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.subject bold
        x.day x.hall faint
      if x.day >= today
        x.day - today "days" bold
      else
        "Done" faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(revise week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(revise prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(revise) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(revise year) faint
  "Last one" since(revise) "days ago" faint

request: Create a stat showing the number of shift entries this week, captioned "shifts" above the average portions stat, just that
program_before:
app "Food Truck" food orange
table shift place pick Campus|Office_park|Market|Stadium|Beach = Campus, sales money, costs money, portions num 1..500 = 80
setting target num = 100 "Portions per shift goal"
let profit = sum(shift, it.sales - it.costs)
topbar shift, "Log shift"
statcard sum(shift.sales week) - sum(shift.costs week), "profit this week"
row gap 2
  stat round(avg(shift.portions week)), "average portions"
  stat round(sum(shift week, it.sales - it.costs) * 100 / max(sum(shift.sales week), 1)), "percent margin"
section "Best place", "profit per place, all time"
  share shift by place, sum(it, it.sales - it.costs), it.key
section "Sales", "last 10 shifts"
  trend shift last 30 days sort at, it.sales
section "Portions per shift", "last 14 days"
  goalbars last 14 days, sum(shift.portions on it), target
section "Latest shifts"
  each shift top 4 as s empty "No shifts logged yet. Log tonight's shift."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.place bold
        s.portions "portions" faint
      stack gap 0 align end
        s.sales - s.costs bold color if(s.sales >= s.costs, good, bad)
        "profit" tiny faint
section "All time", "profit"
  stat profit, "total profit"
section "Portions per place", "all time"
  each options shift.place as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(shift.portions where place = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(shift.portions where place = v) / max(sum(shift.portions), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Newest first", "tap one to edit it"
  each shift top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.place bold
        x.portions "portions" faint
      x.sales bold

let done_pts = sum(task.points where stage = Done)

grid 2 gap 1
  each options task.stage as s
    stack card gap 1
      row
        s head grow
        sum(task.points where stage = s) "pts" faint
      each task where stage = s as t empty "Empty"
        stack radius 8 pad 1 fill soft gap 0 tap edit t swipe remove t
          t.title bold
          t.owner "-" t.points "pts" faint
section "Points done per person"

request: Next, i want a stat card showing how many saving entries there are this week, captioned "entries this week" at the start of the row.
program_before:
app "Umrah fund" mosque mint
table saving amount money, note text?
setting target money = 600000 "Umrah target"
setting monthly money = 25000 "Planned saving per month"
let total = sum(saving.amount)
let p = clamp(total / target, 0, 1)
topbar saving, "Add savings"
row card gap 3 align center
  draw 40, 120 width 60
    rect 14, 6, 12, 92 fill soft radius 6
    rect 14, 98 - 92 * p, 12, 92 * p fill accent radius 6
    circle 20, 106, 12 fill accent
  stack grow gap 0
    total big
    "saved of" target faint
    round(p * 100) "% of the way" faint
quick saving, amount, [5000, 10000, 25000]
section "Months left", "if you keep the plan"
  if(total >= target, 0, floor((target - total) / monthly) + 1) big
  "months until the target, saving" monthly "a month" faint
section "Saved per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, sum(saving.amount month of addmonths(today, it - 6)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "This month's plan", "saved" sum(saving.amount month) "of" monthly
  goal sum(saving.amount month), monthly, "saved this month", ""
section "Biggest deposit"
  max(saving.amount) big
  "Deposits so far" count(saving) faint
section "Deposits"
  list saving by day, "Nothing saved yet. Start with 5000 and keep going."
row gap 2
  statcard count(saving prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(saving) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(saving year) faint
  "Last one" since(saving) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(saving where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(saving on it), 2
section "The numbers", "all time"
  "Average" round(avg(saving.amount)) big
  "Highest" max(saving.amount) faint
  "Lowest" min(saving.amount) faint

program_before:
app "Clean Wash" cup pink
table order customer text, kg num 1..50 = 5 unit "kg", service pick Wash_fold|Dry_clean|Iron_only = Wash_fold, price money, status pick Received|Washing|Ready|Collected = Received
setting capacity num = 120 "Kilos I can wash a day"
state tab pick Received|Washing|Ready|Collected = Received
topbar order, "New order"
goal sum(order.kg today), capacity, "kilos received today", "kg"
row gap 2
  stat sum(order.price where status = Ready), "waiting to be paid"
  stat count(order where status = Ready), "ready to collect"
  stat sum(order.price today), "billed today"

  each options order.status as s

  row card gap 2 tap edit o swipe remove o
    stack grow gap 0
      o.customer bold
      o.kg "kg -" o.service faint
    o.price bold
    if o.status = Received
      button "Wash" tap set o.status = Washing
    if o.status = Washing
      button "Ready" tap set o.status = Ready
    if o.status = Ready
      button "Handed over" tap set o.status = Collected
section "Orders per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(order on it)
section "Services", "this month"
  share order month by service, sum(it.price), it.key
section "Kilos per day", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(order.kg on it), capacity
section "Waiting to be collected"
  each order where status = Ready sort at as o empty "Nothing waiting at the counter."
    row gap 2
      o.customer bold grow
      o.price faint
section "Weekly kilos"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(order.kg week), "kg this week"
    stat sum(order.price week), "billed this week"

program_before:
app "Uptime" bolt ink
table incident service pick Auth|Payments|Search|Gateway|Email = Gateway, severity pick Minor|Major|Outage = Minor, down num 1..600 = 10 unit "min", resolved bool
setting slo num = 99.9 "Uptime target (percent)"
let lost = sum(incident.down month)
let minutes = monthdays(today) * 1440
let uptime = round((1 - lost / minutes) * 10000) / 100
topbar incident, "Log incident"
statcard uptime, "percent uptime, target" slo, 100
row gap 2
  stat lost, "minutes down this month"
  stat count(incident month where severity = Outage), "full outages"
if uptime < slo
  "Below the target. Error budget is spent." color bad bold
section "Open incidents", "tick when resolved"
  each incident where resolved = no sort at as i empty "Nothing open. All services are healthy."
    row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
      toggle i.resolved
      stack grow gap 0
        i.service i.severity bold color if(i.severity = Outage, bad, ink)
        i.down "min down" faint
section "Downtime per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(incident.down on it)
section "Which service fails", "minutes down, all time"
  share incident by service, sum(it.down), it.key
section "Severity mix", "this month"
  bars incident month by severity, count(it), it.key
section "History"
  list incident where resolved = yes top 5, "No resolved incidents yet."
section "Minutes down per service", "this month"
  each options incident.service as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(incident.down month where service = v) "min" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(incident.down month where service = v) / max(lost, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

    row card gap 2
      i.service bold grow
      i.severity faint

request: So pls add a stat card showing how many eaten entries there are this week, captioned "entries this week" above the "entries last week" stat.
program_before:
app "Fridge" box teal
table food name text, kind pick Cooked|Dairy|Veg|Meat|Other = Cooked, made date = today, lasts num 1..30 = 3 unit "days"
table eaten food ref food
let fresh = count(food, count(it.eaten all) = 0)
let old = count(food, count(it.eaten all) = 0 and today - it.made > it.lasts)
topbar food, "Add food"
row gap 2
  statcard fresh, "items in the fridge"
  statcard old, "past their day"
if old > 0
  "Some food is past its day. Smell it, then decide." color warn bold
section "Eat first", "oldest first"
  each food sort made as f empty "The fridge is empty. Add what you cooked tonight."
    if count(f.eaten all) = 0
      row card gap 2 tap edit f swipe remove f
        stack grow gap 0
          f.name bold
          if today - f.made > f.lasts
            "Past its day by" today - f.made - f.lasts "days" color bad small
          else
            f.lasts - (today - f.made) "days left" faint
        toggle f.eaten all
section "By type"
  share food by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Eaten per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(eaten on it)
section "Cooked per week", "last 8 weeks"
  bars 1..8, count(food week of (today - 7 * (8 - it))), join("W", it)
section "Longest lasting"
  max(food.lasts) "days" big

  statcard count(eaten prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(eaten) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(eaten year) faint
  "Last one" since(eaten) "days ago" faint

request: Hey, can the screen have a stat with the caption "already baked" that shows the total price from order (only where ready is yes) below the "to earn" number?
program_before:
app "Bakery Orders" bread pink
table order customer text, item pick Cake|Cupcakes|Bread|Cookies|Pastry = Cake, due date = today, price money, ready bool
setting capacity num = 8 "Orders per day I can bake"
let due_today = count(order where due = today and ready = no)
let late = count(order where due < today and ready = no)
remind "Orders are due today" at 7:30 if due_today > 0
topbar order, "New order"
row gap 2
  stat due_today, "due today"
  stat late, "overdue"
  stat sum(order.price where ready = no), "waiting to bake"
goal count(order where due = today), capacity, "orders booked for today"
each order where ready = no sort due as o empty "No open orders. Add one when a customer calls."
  row card gap 2 tap edit o swipe remove o
    toggle o.ready
    stack grow gap 0
      o.customer bold
      o.item "-" o.due faint color if(o.due < today, bad, muted)
    o.price bold
section "Revenue by item", "all ready orders"
  share order where ready = yes by item, sum(it.price), it.key
section "Orders per day", "next 7 days"
  bars days last 7 days, count(order where due = it), dayname(it)
section "Ready", count(order where ready = yes)
  list order where ready = yes top 5, "Nothing ready yet."
section "Money waiting", "orders not ready yet"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(order.price where ready = no), "to earn"
section "Top customers", "by spend"
  share order by customer, sum(it.price), it.key
section "Booked per weekday", "this week"
  bars days week, count(order where due = it), dayname(it)
if late > 0
  "Late:" plural(late, "order") "past the due date" color bad bold
section "Orders per item", "not ready yet"
  each options order.item as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(order where item = v and ready = no) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(order where item = v and ready = no) / max(count(order where ready = no), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

program_before:
app "Sick day" heart red
table temp who pick Ayan|Hira|Mama|Baba = Ayan, deg num 35..42 = 37 unit "C", symptom pick Fever|Cough|Sore_throat|Headache|Stomach|None = Fever, note text?
setting fever_at num = 38 "Call a doctor above (C)"

topbar title, "Add title"

request: thrrow in a stat showing the total sales from campaign this month, captioned "sales" right after the leads stat!
program_before:
app "Ad Spend" chart yellow
table campaign name text, channel pick Facebook|Google|Instagram|Flyers|WhatsApp = Facebook, spend money, leads num 0..5000 = 0, sales num 0..5000 = 0
setting budget money = 100000 "Monthly ad budget"
let spent = sum(campaign.spend month)
topbar campaign, "Add campaign"
statcard spent, "spent this month of" budget, budget
row gap 2
  stat sum(campaign.leads month), "leads"
  stat round(spent / max(sum(campaign.leads month), 1)), "cost per lead"
section "Cost per lead", "by channel, this month"
  bars campaign month by channel, round(sum(it.spend) / max(sum(it.leads), 1)), it.key
section "Spend", "by channel"
  share campaign month by channel, sum(it.spend), it.key
section "Leads to sales"
  each options campaign.channel as c
    row gap 2
      c bold grow
      sum(campaign.sales month where channel = c) "of" sum(campaign.leads month where channel = c) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(campaign.sales month where channel = c) / max(sum(campaign.leads month where channel = c), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Spend per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, sum(campaign.spend on it)
section "Best campaigns", "most sales"
  each campaign sort sales desc top 3 as c empty "No campaigns yet. Add the first one."
    row card gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c
      stack grow gap 0
        c.name bold
        c.channel faint
      c.sales "sales" bold
if spent > budget
  "Over the ad budget. Pause the weakest channel." color bad bold
list campaign top 5, "No campaigns yet."
section "Newest first", "tap one to edit it"
  each campaign top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        x.channel faint
      x.spend bold

request: New: a stat showing the number of invoice entries this month, captioned "sent this month" below the "biggest invoice" number
program_before:
app "Invoices" money teal
table invoice client text, amount money, issued date = today, paid bool
setting goal money = 250000 "Monthly income goal"
let owed = sum(invoice.amount where paid = no)
let late = count(invoice where paid = no and issued < today - 30)
topbar invoice, "New invoice"

if late > 0
  "Chase" plural(late, "invoice") "older than 30 days" bold color bad

  each invoice where paid = no sort issued as i empty "Everything is paid. Enjoy it."
    row card gap 2 tap edit i swipe remove i
      toggle i.paid
      stack grow gap 0
        i.client bold
        "Issued" i.issued faint color if(i.issued < today - 30, bad, muted)
      i.amount bold
section "Paid", count(invoice where paid = yes)
  list invoice where paid = yes top 6, "Nothing paid yet."

request: throw in a progress bar of the number of patient entries today toward the capacity, captioned "patients seen or waiting today", with the unit "patients" at the very top
program_before:
app "Clinic Queue" heart teal
table patient name text, reason pick Fever|Checkup|Injury|Child|Other = Checkup, status pick Waiting|With_doctor|Done = Waiting, fee money = 500
setting capacity num = 40 "Patients a day"
state tab pick Waiting|With_doctor|Done = Waiting
topbar patient, "Add patient"
row gap 2
  stat count(patient where status = Waiting), "waiting now"
  stat count(patient today where status = Done), "done today"
  stat sum(patient.fee today where status = Done), "fees collected"
row gap 1
  each options patient.status as s
    button s count(patient today where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s
each patient today where status = tab sort at as p empty "Nobody in this list right now."
  row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
    text index + 1 bold
    stack grow gap 0
      p.name bold
      p.reason faint
    if p.status = Waiting
      button "Call in" tap set p.status = With_doctor
    if p.status = With_doctor
      button "Done" tap set p.status = Done

  goalbars last 14 days, count(patient on it), capacity
section "Reasons", "this month"
  share patient month by reason, count(it), it.key

  daybars last 7 days, sum(patient.fee on it where status = Done)

  each options patient.reason as r
    row gap 2
      r bold grow
      count(patient week where reason = r) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(patient week where reason = r) / max(count(patient week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

  "Long queue. Call a second doctor." color warn bold

app "Juice Bar" cup orange
table sale drink pick Orange|Mango|Sugarcane|Carrot|Mix = Orange, price money = 150

"Juice Bar" head
choice flavour
quick sale, price, [100, 150, 200, 250]
button "Sell a" flavour "for 150" tap add sale drink = flavour, price = 150
statcard sum(sale.price today), "taken today of" target, target

  stat count(sale week), "glasses this week"
  stat round(sum(sale.price today) / max(count(sale today), 1)), "average per glass"

    row gap 2

      draw 100, 4 width 70
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(sale today where drink = f) / max(count(sale today), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  heat last 35 days, count(sale on it), 40
list sale today, "No sales yet today. Tap a price when the first glass goes."
section "Best day", "this month"
  stat max(days month, sum(sale.price on it)), "taken in one day"
section "Totals", "this month"
  row gap 2
    stat count(sale month), "glasses"
    stat sum(sale.price month), "takings"
if count(sale today) = 0
  "Quiet so far today. Set up the fruit." faint

  each sale top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."

table trade animal pick Cow|Buffalo|Goat|Calf|Bull = Goat, weight num 20..900 = 100 unit "kg", bought money, sold money = 0, status pick Holding|Sold = Holding
table feedcost animal text, amount money
setting target money = 120000 "Monthly profit goal"
let profit = sum(trade month where status = Sold, it.sold - it.bought) - sum(feedcost.amount month)
topbar trade, "Buy animal"
statcard profit, "profit this month of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat count(trade where status = Holding), "in the yard"
  stat sum(trade.bought where status = Holding), "money tied up"
  stat count(trade month where status = Sold), "sold this month"
section "In the yard", "tap Close deal when sold"
  each trade where status = Holding sort at as t empty "The yard is empty. Add the next animal you buy."
    row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
      stack grow gap 0
        t.animal bold
        t.weight "kg, bought for" t.bought faint
      button "Close deal" tap edit t
section "Profit by animal", "sold this month"
  bars trade month where status = Sold by animal, sum(it, it.sold - it.bought), it.key
section "Deals per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(trade on it)
section "Weight bought", "last 7 days"
  trend days last 7 days, sum(trade.weight on it)
section "Feed and medicine", "this month"
  stat sum(feedcost.amount month), "spent so far"
  each feedcost top 3 as f empty "No feed costs yet. Add one below."
    row gap 2
      f.animal bold grow
      f.amount faint
form feedcost, "Add feed cost"
section "Sold", count(trade where status = Sold)
  list trade where status = Sold top 6, "No animals sold yet."
if profit >= target
  "Monthly goal reached." color good bold
section "Animals in the yard", "by kind"
  each options trade.animal as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(trade where animal = v and status = Holding) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(trade where animal = v and status = Holding) / max(count(trade where status = Holding), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

app "Stretching" walk green
table stretch name text, secs num 10..300 = 30 unit "sec", area pick Neck|Back|Legs|Arms|Hips = Back
table did stretch ref stretch
let n = count(stretch)
let finished = count(did today)
let full_days = count(days month, count(did on it) >= n and n > 0)
topbar stretch, "Add stretch"
statcard finished, "of" n "stretches done today", n
if finished = n and n > 0
  "Routine complete. Your body says thanks." head
section "Today's routine", "total" sum(stretch.secs) "seconds"
  each stretch sort area as s empty "No stretches yet. Add neck rolls, a forward fold, a hip opener."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.name bold
        s.area s.secs "sec" faint
      toggle s.did
section "Full routine days", "this week"
  weekdots count(did on it) >= n and n > 0
  "Full days this month:" full_days faint
section "Stretches done per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(did on it)
section "Areas worked", "this month"
  each options stretch.area as a
    row gap 1
      a grow
      count(did month where stretch.area = a) bold
section "Least done", "this month"
  each stretch sort count(it.did month) top 3 as s empty "Add stretches to see this."
    row gap 2
      s.name grow
      count(s.did month) "times" faint
section "Month grid", "darker is more stretches"
  daygrid last 28 days, count(did on it), max(n, 1)
section "Streak"
  streak(did) "days in a row" big
  "Best run" best(did) "days" faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(did week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(did prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(did) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(did year) faint
  "Last one" since(did) "days ago" faint

table student name text, fee money
table feepaid student ref student, amount money
table exam subject text, on_date date
table teacher name text, salary money
state m date = today
monthnav m
"Profit this month" sum(feepaid.amount month of m) - sum(teacher.salary) big
row gap 2
  stat sum(feepaid.amount month of m), "fees collected"

    e.on_date

app "Shaadi Catering" gift plum
table event client text, date date, guests num 20..2000 = 200, rate money, advance money = 0, kind pick Wedding|Walima|Mehndi|Birthday|Corporate = Wedding
setting heads num = 800 "Guests I can serve a week"
let total = sum(event, it.guests * it.rate)
let balance = sum(event where date >= today, it.guests * it.rate - it.advance)
topbar event, "Book event"
statcard balance, "still to collect from" count(event where date >= today) "events"
row gap 2
  stat count(event where date >= today and date <= today + 7), "events this week"
  stat sum(event.guests where date >= today and date <= today + 7), "guests this week"
  stat sum(event.advance where date >= today), "advance held"
goal sum(event.guests where date >= today and date <= today + 7), heads, "of weekly capacity", "guests"
section "Coming up", "nearest first"
  each event where date >= today sort date top 6 as e empty "No upcoming events. Add the next booking."
    row card gap 2 tap edit e swipe remove e
      stack grow gap 0
        e.client e.kind bold
        e.date "-" e.guests "guests" faint
      stack gap 0 align end
        e.guests * e.rate - e.advance bold
        "balance" tiny faint
section "Events by kind", "all time"
  share event by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Revenue per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(event month of it, it.guests * it.rate), monthname(it)
section "Booked value", "all events"
  stat total, "total booked"
section "Guests per kind", "upcoming"
  each options event.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      sum(event.guests where kind = v and date >= today) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(event.guests where kind = v and date >= today) / max(sum(event.guests where date >= today), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Just added", "tap one to edit it"
  each event top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.client bold
        x.kind x.date faint
      x.guests "guests" bold

app "Dairy Log" milk blue
table milk cow pick Gauri|Laali|Moti|Kali|Chandni = Gauri, litres num 1..40 = 8 unit "L", shift pick Morning|Evening = Morning
setting price money = 140 "Price per litre"
setting goal num = 60 "Daily herd goal (L)"
state sh pick Morning|Evening = Morning
let today_l = sum(milk.litres today)
topbar milk, "Add milking"
statcard today_l, "litres today of" goal, goal
row gap 2
  stat today_l * price, "earned today"
  stat sum(milk.litres week) * price, "earned this week"
section "Shift view"
  choice sh
  each options milk.cow as c
    row gap 2
      c bold grow
      sum(milk.litres today where cow = c and shift = sh) "L" faint
      draw 100, 4 width 90
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(milk.litres today where cow = c and shift = sh) / 12, 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Last 7 days", "average" round(sum(milk.litres last 7 days) / 7) "L a day"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(milk.litres on it), goal
section "Best cows this month", "litres"

list milk today by day, "No milking logged today. Add the morning shift first."
section "Evening against morning", "this week"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(milk.litres week where shift = Morning), "L morning"
    stat sum(milk.litres week where shift = Evening), "L evening"
section "Litres per day", "last 14 days"
  trend days last 14 days, sum(milk.litres on it)
section "Best day this month", "litres"
  stat max(days month, sum(milk.litres on it)), "L in one day"
section "Month income", "at the price per litre"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(milk.litres month) * price, "earned"

        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(sum(milk.litres week where shift = v) / max(sum(milk.litres week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

app "Solar payback" sun purple
state kw num = 5
state cost money = 150000
state sun num = 4
state tariff money = 40
state loss num = 0.5

let paid_back = cost * kw / max(yearly, 1)
let left10 = pow(1 - loss / 100, 10)
section "Your system"
  "Size" kw "kW" faint
  slider kw 1..20
  field cost "Cost per kW"
  "Sun hours (units per kW a day)" sun faint
  slider sun 2..6
  field tariff "What you pay per unit"
  "Panel loss per year" loss "%" faint
  slider loss 0..2
if yearly = 0
  "Fill in the prices to see how fast it pays back." faint
else
  statcard round(paid_back * 10) / 10, "years to pay back"
  row gap 2
    stat round(yearly), "saved in year one"
    stat round(left10 * 100), "% output after 10 years"
  section "Total saved over 10 years", "minus cost"
    trend 1..10, yearly * it - cost * kw

table night slept time, woke time
table bill name text, amount money, due date, paid bool
table task what text, done bool

table point team pick Lane_1|Lane_2, pts num 1..750 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Lane_1)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Lane_2)
setting winat num = 200 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Lane 1" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Lane_1, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+10" tap add point team = Lane_1, pts = 10
  stack card grow align center
    "Lane 2" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Lane_2, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+10" tap add point team = Lane_2, pts = 10
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
if a >= winat
  "Lane 1 win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Lane 2 win!" head color good
list point

program_before:
app "Chores" home teal
table chore name text, who pick Ali|Sara|Mama|Baba = Ali, stars num 1..5 = 1
table done chore ref chore
state who_filter pick All|Ali|Sara|Mama|Baba = All
let finished = count(done today)
let all = count(chore)
topbar chore, "Add chore"
statcard finished, "of" all "chores done today", all
row gap 1
  each options chore.who as w
    button w count(chore where who = w) fill if(who_filter = w, accent, soft) tap set who_filter = w
  button "Everyone" fill if(who_filter = All, accent, soft) tap set who_filter = All
each chore where who_filter = All or who = who_filter sort who as c empty "No chores here yet. Add one with Add chore."
  row card gap 2 tap edit c swipe remove c
    stack grow gap 0
      c.name bold
      c.who "earns" c.stars "stars" faint
    toggle c.done
section "Stars this week", "who is ahead"
  each options chore.who as w
    row gap 1
      w grow
      sum(done week where chore.who = w, it.chore.stars) "stars" bold
section "Chores finished per day"
  goalbars last 7 days, count(done on it), all
section "Month grid", "darker means more done"
  daygrid last 28 days, count(done on it), max(all, 1)
section "Hardest worker", "this week"
  each options chore.who as w
    stack gap 0
      row
        w grow

table shoot client text, kind pick Wedding|Portrait|Product|Event|Passport = Portrait, date date, fee money, advance money = 0, delivered bool
setting weekly num = 4 "Shoots I can take a week"
let balance = sum(shoot, it.fee - it.advance)
topbar shoot, "Book shoot"
statcard balance, "balance still to collect"
goal count(shoot where date >= today and date <= today + 6), weekly, "shoots in the next 7 days", "shoots"
section "Upcoming", "nearest first"
  each shoot where date >= today sort date top 5 as s empty "Nothing booked. Add the next shoot."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      stack grow gap 0
        s.client bold
        s.kind "-" s.date faint
      s.fee - s.advance bold
section "To deliver", "photos not delivered yet"
  each shoot where date < today and delivered = no as s empty "All photos delivered."
    row card gap 2
      toggle s.delivered
      s.client bold grow
      s.kind faint
section "Income by shoot type"
  share shoot by kind, sum(it.fee), it.key
section "Shoots per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, count(shoot month of it), monthname(it)
section "Average fee"
  stat round(avg(shoot.fee)), "per shoot"
section "Shoots per type", "all time"
  each options shoot.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(shoot where kind = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(shoot where kind = v) / max(count(shoot), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Newest first", "tap one to edit it"
  each shoot top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.client bold
        x.kind faint
      x.fee bold

program_before:
app "Loan" calc slate
table quote bank text, amount money, rate num 0..60, months num 1..360
setting amount money = 500000 "Loan amount"
setting rate num = 12 "Yearly interest (percent)"
setting months num = 24 "Months to repay"
let r = rate / 1200
let emi = if(r > 0, amount * r * pow(1 + r, months) / (pow(1 + r, months) - 1), amount / months)
let interest = emi * months - amount
screen calc "Calculator" calc
  field amount
  field rate
  field months
  slider rate 0..40
  slider months 6..120
  "Monthly installment" faint
  round(emi) big
  row gap 2
    statcard round(interest), "total interest"
    statcard round(emi * months), "total to pay"
  section "How much is interest", "share:" round(interest * 100 / max(emi * months, 1)) "%"
    goal interest, max(emi * months, 1), "of everything you pay", ""
screen saved "Saved quotes" list
  topbar quote, "Save quote"
  each quote sort rate as q empty "No quotes saved. Add what each bank offers."
    row card gap 2 tap edit q swipe remove q
      stack grow gap 0
        q.bank bold
        q.amount "at" q.rate "% for" q.months "months" faint
  section "Cheapest rate"
    min(quote.rate) "%" big
  section "Interest compared"
    bars quote, it.amount * it.rate / 100 * it.months / 12, it.bank

program_before:
app "Habits" check mint
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
row gap 2
  goal done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" max(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0
  "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day." faint
each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1
      each days last 7 days
        stack grow align center tap toggle h.check on it
          dayname(it) tiny color muted
          box height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% last 30 days"
"Last 10 weeks" head
grid 7 gap 1
  each days last 70 days
    box height 12 radius 2 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)
"Each row is a week. Darker means more habits done." faint
form habit

app "Habits" check mint
table habit name text
table check habit ref habit
let n = count(habit)
let done = count(check today)
row gap 2
  goal done, n, "done today"
  stack grow
    if(done = n and n > 0, "All done today", "Keep going") head
    "Best streak" max(habit, streak(it.check)) "days" faint
if n = 0
  "Start with one small thing you can do on a busy day." faint
each habit as h
  stack card gap 1 tap edit h swipe remove h
    row gap 2
      h.name bold grow
      streak(h.check) "days" faint
      toggle h.check
    row gap 1
      each days last 7 days
        stack grow align center tap toggle h.check on it
          dayname(it) tiny color muted
          box height 10 radius 5 fill if(count(h.check on it) > 0, accent, soft)
row gap 2
  stat round(count(check week) * 100 / (n * weekday(today))), "% this week"
  stat round(count(check last 30 days) * 100 / (n * 30)), "% last 30 days"
"Last 10 weeks" head
grid 7 gap 1
  each days last 70 days
    box height 12 radius 2 fill if(count(check on it) > 0, accent, soft) opacity clamp(count(check on it) / n, 0.3, 1)
"Each row is a week. Darker means more habits done." faint
form habit

app "Blood Pressure" heart ink
table bp sys num 60..260 = 120 "Upper", dia num 30..160 = 80 "Lower", pulse num? 30..220
topbar bp, "Add reading"
stack card gap 1
  "Last reading" faint
  if count(bp) = 0
    "No readings yet" head
  else
    last(bp.sys) "/" last(bp.dia) big
    if last(bp.sys) >= 140 or last(bp.dia) >= 90
      "High. Rest and measure again." color bad
    else
      "In a normal range" color good
row gap 2
  statcard round(avg(bp.sys week)), "average upper, this week"
  statcard round(avg(bp.dia week)), "average lower, this week"
section "Last 14 days", "upper in colour, lower in grey"
  plot 0..13, 40..200 axes gridlines
    poly stroke accent thick 2
      each days last 14 days
        if count(bp on it) > 0
          pt index, sum(bp.sys on it) / count(bp on it)
    poly stroke muted thick 2
      each days last 14 days
        if count(bp on it) > 0
          pt index, sum(bp.dia on it) / count(bp on it)
each bp sort at desc top 8 as b empty "Nothing here yet. Add a reading after you rest for five minutes."
  row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
    b.sys "/" b.dia bold
    b.pulse "bpm" faint grow
    b.at faint

app "Data Packs" phone mint
state p1 money = 0
state g1 num = 5
state p2 money = 0
state g2 num = 20
state p3 money = 0
state g3 num = 50
let u1 = if(g1 > 0, p1 / g1, 0)
let u2 = if(g2 > 0, p2 / g2, 0)
let u3 = if(g3 > 0, p3 / g3, 0)
let best = min(u1, min(u2, u3))
row gap 2
  field p1 "Pack 1 price"
  field g1 "GB"
row gap 2
  field p2 "Pack 2 price"
  field g2 "GB"
row gap 2
  field p3 "Pack 3 price"
  field g3 "GB"
if p1 > 0 and p2 > 0 and p3 > 0
  section "Price per GB"
    row pad 1 radius 2 fill if(u1 = best, accent, soft)
      "Pack 1" grow
      round(u1 * 100) / 100 bold
    row pad 1 radius 2 fill if(u2 = best, accent, soft)
      "Pack 2" grow
      round(u2 * 100) / 100 bold
    row pad 1 radius 2 fill if(u3 = best, accent, soft)
      "Pack 3" grow
      round(u3 * 100) / 100 bold
  "Best pack is" round((1 - best / max(u1, max(u2, u3))) * 100) "% cheaper than the dearest." faint
else
  "Type all three prices." faint

app "Zakat check" coin ocean
table paid amount money, note text?
state cash money = 0
state bank money = 0
state gold num = 0
state owed money = 0
state gold_rate money = 0
state silver_rate money = 0
state basis pick Silver|Gold = Silver
let wealth = cash + bank + gold * gold_rate - owed
let nisab = if(basis = Silver, 612.36 * silver_rate, 87.48 * gold_rate)
let due = if(nisab > 0 and wealth >= nisab, wealth * 0.025, 0)
row bar
  "Zakat check" head grow
section "What you hold"
  field cash "Cash in hand"
  field bank "Bank and savings"
  field gold "Gold (grams)"
  field owed "Debts due now"
section "Today's rates", "per gram"
  field gold_rate "Gold"
  field silver_rate "Silver"
  row gap 1
    "Nisab by" faint
    choice basis
if nisab = 0
  "Type today's gold or silver rate to see the nisab." faint
else
  statcard round(due), if(wealth >= nisab, "zakat due at 2.5%", "below nisab, no zakat due")
  goal max(wealth, 0), nisab, "net wealth against nisab"
  button "Mark as paid" tap add paid amount = round(due), note = "Zakat"
section "Paid so far", sum(paid.amount)
  list paid top 6, "Nothing recorded yet."

app "Wheat Harvest" leaf green
table cut field pick North_field|River_field|Back_plot|Canal_side = North_field, bags num 1..500, kgbag num 20..100 = 50 unit "kg"

    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s

        s.buyer bold
        s.bags "bags at" s.rate faint
      s.bags * s.rate bold
form sale, "Add sale"
section "Recent cutting"
  list cut top 8, "No cutting logged yet. Log the first field after harvest."
section "Fields still to cut", "no bags logged this week"
  each options cut.field as f
    if count(cut week where field = f) = 0
      row gap 2
        f bold grow
        "Nothing cut" faint
section "Average bag weight", "by field"
  bars cut by field, round(avg(it.kgbag)), it.key
section "Cut and sold", "bags"
  row gap 2
    stat total, "cut"
    stat sold, "sold"
    stat total - sold, "left"
if total >= target
  "Season target reached." color good bold

program_before:
app "Crop Profit" plant green
state yield num = 40
state price money = 0
state seed money = 0
state fert money = 0
state water money = 0
state labour money = 0
state acres num = 5
let income = yield * price
let costs = seed + fert + water + labour
section "Income per acre"
  row gap 2
    field yield "Maunds"
    field price "Price per maund"
section "Costs per acre", costs
  row gap 2
    field seed "Seed"
    field fert "Fertiliser"
  row gap 2
    field water "Water"
    field labour "Labour"
field acres "Acres"
if price > 0
  statcard round(income - costs), if(income >= costs, "profit per acre", "loss per acre")
  stat round((income - costs) * acres), "for all" plural(acres, "acre")
else
  "Type the price per maund to see the profit." faint

app "Recipes" food orange
table recipe name text, kind pick Curry|Rice|Bread|Sweet|Snack|Soup = Curry, mins num 5..300 = 30 unit "min", hearts bool
table cooked recipe ref recipe
state kind_filter pick All|Curry|Rice|Bread|Sweet|Snack|Soup = All
let n = count(recipe)
topbar recipe, "Add recipe"
row gap 2
  statcard n, "recipes in the book"
  statcard count(cooked month), "dishes cooked this month"
row gap 1
  button "All" fill if(kind_filter = All, accent, soft) tap set kind_filter = All
  each options recipe.kind as k
    button k fill if(kind_filter = k, accent, soft) tap set kind_filter = k
each recipe where kind_filter = All or kind = kind_filter sort name as r empty "No recipes here. Write down the one your mother makes best."
  row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
    stack grow gap 0
      r.name bold
      r.kind r.mins "min, cooked" count(r.cooked all) "times" faint
    toggle r.hearts
    button "Cooked" tap add cooked recipe = r
section "Family favourites"
  each recipe where hearts = yes sort name as r empty "Tap the heart on a recipe to make it a favourite."
    row gap 2
      icon heart
      r.name grow
section "Cooked per week", "last 8 weeks"
  bars 1..8, count(cooked week of (today - 7 * (8 - it))), join("W", it)
section "Most cooked"
  each recipe sort count(it.cooked all) desc top 3 as r empty "Cook something to see this."
    row gap 2
      r.name grow
      count(r.cooked all) "times" bold
section "Quick meals", "under 30 minutes"
  count(recipe where mins <= 30) big
row gap 2
  statcard count(cooked week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(cooked prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(cooked) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(cooked year) faint
  "Last one" since(cooked) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(cooked where dayname(at) = it), it

app "Care Circle" heart red
table carer name text, role pick Doctor|Nurse|Family|Neighbour|Pharmacy = Family, phone text

  topbar carer, "Add person"

        c.name bold

program_before:
app "Calc" calc slate dark
state acc num = 0
state cur num = 0
state op pick Add|Sub|Mul|Div|Nop = Nop
table tape answer num
let res = if(op = Add, acc + cur, if(op = Sub, acc - cur, if(op = Mul, acc * cur, if(op = Div, acc / cur, cur))))
stack card gap 0 align end
  if op != Nop
    acc if(op = Add, "+", if(op = Sub, "-", if(op = Mul, "x", "/"))) faint
  cur huge
grid 4 gap 1
  each [7, 8, 9] as n
    button n tap set cur = cur * 10 + n
  button "/" fill soft tap set acc = res then set cur = 0 then set op = Div
  each [4, 5, 6] as n
    button n tap set cur = cur * 10 + n
  button "x" fill soft tap set acc = res then set cur = 0 then set op = Mul
  each [1, 2, 3] as n
    button n tap set cur = cur * 10 + n
  button "-" fill soft tap set acc = res then set cur = 0 then set op = Sub
  button "C" fill bad tap set cur = 0 then set acc = 0 then set op = Nop
  button "0" tap set cur = cur * 10
  button "=" fill accent tap add tape answer = res then set cur = res then set acc = 0 then set op = Nop
  button "+" fill soft tap set acc = res then set cur = 0 then set op = Add
section "Tape", "last answers"
  list tape top 5, "Answers show here after you press ="

state d1 num = 30
state d2 num = 20
state d3 num = 10
let days = d1 + d2 + d3
let perday = if(days > 0, bill / days, 0)
field bill "Electricity bill"
row gap 2
  field d1 "Person 1 days"
  field d2 "Person 2 days"
  field d3 "Person 3 days"
if bill > 0 and days > 0
  statcard round(perday * 100) / 100, "per person-day"
  section "Each person pays"
    row
      "Person 1" grow
      round(perday * d1) bold
    row
      "Person 2" grow
      round(perday * d2) bold
    row
      "Person 3" grow
      round(perday * d3) bold
    draw 100, 6
      rect 0, 0, 100 * d1 / days, 6 fill accent
      rect 100 * d1 / days, 0, 100 * d2 / days, 6 fill warn
      rect 100 * (d1 + d2) / days, 0, 100 * d3 / days, 6 fill muted
else
  "Type the bill and the days to see the split." faint

state mins num = 400
state fee_a money = 800
state free_a num = 300
state rate_a money = 2
state fee_b money = 600
state free_b num = 200
state rate_b money = 1.5
let cost_a = fee_a + max(mins - free_a, 0) * rate_a
let cost_b = fee_b + max(mins - free_b, 0) * rate_b
field mins "Minutes I talk each month"
section "Plan A"
  field fee_a "Monthly fee"
  field free_a "Free minutes"
  field rate_a "Per extra minute"
section "Plan B"
  field fee_b "Monthly fee"
  field free_b "Free minutes"
  field rate_b "Per extra minute"
row gap 2
  statcard round(cost_b), "plan B a month"
if cost_a = cost_b
  "Same price on both plans." bold
else
  if(cost_a < cost_b, "Plan A", "Plan B") "saves you" round(abs(cost_a - cost_b)) "a month" big color good

app "Column steel" tool ocean
state cols num = 8
state ht num = 10
state bars num = 4
state dia pick D12|D16|D20 = D12
state side num = 9
state gap num = 6
setting rate money = 280 "Steel per kg"
let d = if(dia = D12, 12, if(dia = D16, 16, 20))
let bar_len = ht * 0.3048 + 0.6
let rings = floor(ht * 12 / max(gap, 1)) + 1
let ring_len = 4 * (side - 3) * 0.0254 + 0.25
let main_kg = cols * bars * bar_len * pow(d, 2) / 162
let ring_kg = cols * rings * ring_len * pow(8, 2) / 162
section "Columns"
  field cols "How many columns"
  field ht "Height (feet)"
  field side "Side of column (inches)"
section "Bars"
  "Main bars" bars faint
  slider bars 4..12
  choice dia
  "Stirrups (8 mm) every" gap "inches" faint
  slider gap 3..9
statcard round(main_kg + ring_kg), "kg of steel in all"
row gap 2
  stat round(main_kg), "kg main bars"
  stat round(ring_kg), "kg stirrups"
"Steel cost" round((main_kg + ring_kg) * rate) head

app "Shop zakat" bag ocean
table yearly amount money, year num 2000..2100
setting stock money = 0 "Stock at market price"
setting till money = 0 "Cash and bank"
setting owed_in money = 0 "Customers owe me"
setting owed_out money = 0 "I owe suppliers"
setting silver money = 0 "Silver rate per gram"
let net = stock + till + owed_in - owed_out
let nisab = silver * 612.36
let due = if(nisab > 0 and net >= nisab, net * 0.025, 0)
row bar
  "Shop zakat" head grow
section "Business wealth"
  field stock
  field till
  field owed_in
  field owed_out
field silver
if nisab = 0
  "Enter the silver rate to check the nisab." faint
else
  statcard round(due), if(net >= nisab, "zakat due at 2.5%", "below nisab, no zakat due")
  button "Save for this year" tap add yearly amount = round(due), year = year(today)
section "Past years", "zakat paid"
  if count(yearly) > 0
    bars yearly sort year top 6, it.amount, it.year
  else
    "No year saved yet. Tap Save for this year." faint

app "Guess the Number" game mint
table attempt gm num, value num 1..100
setting game num = 1 "Round"
state secret num = 42
state g num = 50
let tries = count(attempt where gm = game)
let latest = last(attempt.value where gm = game)
let found = latest = secret
"Guess a number from 1 to 100" head
if found
  "You got it in" plural(tries, "try") big color good
else
  if tries > 0
    if(latest > secret, "Too high", "Too low") big color warn
  else
    "Slide to a number, then press Guess." faint
"Your guess" g big
slider g 1..100
if not found
  button "Guess" fill accent tap add attempt gm = game, value = g

table work client pick Acme|Bloom|Nova|Internal = Acme, task text, hours num 1..12 = 2 unit "h"

topbar work, "Log hours"
goal week_h, target, "hours this week", "h"
row gap 2

  stat round(sum(work.hours month) / max(count(days month, count(work on it) > 0), 1) * 10) / 10, "hours per working day"
section "Hours per day", "last 14 days"

  bars work month by client, sum(it.hours) * rate, it.key

app "Light bill" bolt orange
table month units num 0..3000, label text
state units num = 220
state tax num = 17
setting fixed money = 150 "Fixed charge"
let rate = if(units <= 100, 7, if(units <= 200, 11, if(units <= 300, 17, 24)))
let energy = units * rate
let bill = energy * (1 + tax / 100) + fixed
section "Meter reading"
  "Units used" units faint
  slider units 0..800
  "Tax" tax "%" faint
  slider tax 0..25
if units = 0
  "Slide the units to see the bill." faint
else
  statcard round(bill), "estimated bill"
  row gap 2
    stat rate, "per unit slab"
    stat round(energy), "energy charge"
  button "Save this month" tap add month units = units, label = monthname(today)
section "Saved months", "units"
  if count(month) > 0
    bars month top 6, it.units, it.label
  else
    "Nothing saved yet. Tap Save this month." faint

app "Watchlist" cards purple
table title name text, kind pick Movie|Series|Documentary|Anime = Movie, status pick Want|Watching|Watched = Want, stars num? 1..5, finished date?
state tab pick Want|Watching|Watched = Want
topbar title, "Add title"
row gap 2
  statcard count(title where status = Watched), "watched"
  statcard count(title where status = Want), "on the list"
row gap 1
  each options title.status as s
    button s count(title where status = s) fill if(tab = s, ink, surface) grow tap set tab = s
each title where status = tab sort name as t empty "Nothing here yet. Add a film someone told you about."
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    stack grow gap 0
      t.name bold
      t.kind t.stars faint
    if t.status = Want
      button "Start" tap set t.status = Watching
    if t.status = Watching
      button "Finished" tap set t.status = Watched then set t.finished = today
section "Watched per month", "last 6 months"
  bars 1..6, count(title where finished >= addmonths(today, it - 6) and finished < addmonths(today, it - 5)), monthname(addmonths(today, it - 6))
section "What you like", "watched by kind"
  share title where status = Watched by kind, count(it), it.key
section "Top rated"
  each title sort stars desc top 3 as t empty "Rate a title to see your favourites."
    row gap 2
      t.name grow
      t.stars "stars" bold
section "Average rating"
  round(avg(title.stars) * 10) / 10 big
  "out of 5 across" count(title where stars > 0) "rated titles" faint
row gap 2
  statcard count(title week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(title prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(title) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(title year) faint
  "Last one" since(title) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(title where dayname(at) = it), it

app "Better Pack" package ocean
state sa num = 500
state pa money = 0
state sb num = 750
state pb money = 0
state per pick Per_100|Per_1000 = Per_100
let k = if(per = Per_100, 100, 1000)
let ua = if(sa > 0, pa / sa * k, 0)
let ub = if(sb > 0, pb / sb * k, 0)
"Pack A" head
row gap 2
  field sa "Size"
  field pa "Price"
"Pack B" head
row gap 2
  field sb "Size"
  field pb "Price"
choice per
if pa > 0 and pb > 0
  statcard round(abs(ua - ub) * 100 / max(ua, ub)), if(ua = ub, "percent difference: same price", if(ua < ub, "percent cheaper: Pack A wins", "percent cheaper: Pack B wins"))

app "Loan Compare" coin blue dark
state amt money = 1000000
state r1 num = 14
state y1 num = 3
state r2 num = 12
state y2 num = 5
let m1 = r1 / 1200
let m2 = r2 / 1200
let pay1 = if(m1 > 0, amt * m1 / (1 - pow(1 + m1, -12 * y1)), amt / (12 * y1))
let pay2 = if(m2 > 0, amt * m2 / (1 - pow(1 + m2, -12 * y2)), amt / (12 * y2))
let int1 = pay1 * 12 * y1 - amt
let int2 = pay2 * 12 * y2 - amt
field amt "Loan amount"
row gap 2
  stack grow
    "Offer one" bold
    "Rate" r1 "%" faint
    slider r1 0..40
    "Years" y1 faint
    slider y1 1..30
  stack grow
    "Offer two" bold
    "Rate" r2 "%" faint
    slider r2 0..40
    "Years" y2 faint
    slider y2 1..30
row gap 2
  statcard round(pay1), "per month, offer one"
  statcard round(pay2), "per month, offer two"
"Total interest:" round(int1) "vs" round(int2) faint
if amt > 0
  if int1 < int2
    "Offer one costs" round(int2 - int1) "less overall." bold color good
  else
    "Offer two costs" round(int1 - int2) "less overall." bold color good

setting weekly_hours num = 15 "Study hours per week"
let hours = sum(study.mins week) / 60
topbar study, "Log study"
statcard round(hours * 10) / 10, "hours this week, goal" weekly_hours, weekly_hours
quick study, mins, [30, 45, 60]
section "Minutes per day", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(study.mins on it), weekly_hours * 60 / 7
section "By subject", "this month"
  share study month by subject, sum(it.mins), it.key
section "Study days", "last 10 weeks"
  heat last 70 days, count(study on it), 3
row gap 2
  statcard streak(study), "day streak"
  statcard round(sum(study.mins month) / 60), "hours this month"
section "Weak spots", "least studied this month"
  each options study.subject as s
    row gap 1
      s grow
      round(sum(study.mins month where subject = s) / 60 * 10) / 10 "h" bold
section "Topics lately"
  each study where topic != "" top 5 as t empty "Add a topic when you log study so you can see what you covered."
    row gap 2
      t.topic grow
      t.mins "min" faint
section "Study log"
  list study by day, "No study logged. Tap 30 after your first block."
row gap 2
  statcard count(study week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(study prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(study) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(study year) faint
  "Last one" since(study) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(study where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(study on it), 2
section "The numbers", "all time"
  "Average" round(avg(study.mins) * 10) / 10 "min" big
  "Highest" max(study.mins) "min" faint
  "Lowest" min(study.mins) "min" faint

table member name text, slot num 1..40
table deposit member ref member, amount money
setting installment money = 5000 "Monthly installment"

let pot = installment * count(member)
let receiver = nth(member sort slot, turn_no).name
"Pot this month" pot big
"Receives:" receiver head
row gap 1
  button "<" tap set turn_no = max(turn_no - 1, 1)
  button ">" tap set turn_no = turn_no + 1
each member sort slot as m
  row card
    m.slot bold
    m.name grow
    sum(m.deposit.amount month) "paid" color if(sum(m.deposit.amount month) >= installment, good, warn)

app "Clinic Tokens" bell mint dark
table token name text, seen bool
let waiting = count(token today where seen = no)
topbar token, "New token"
stack card gap 2 align center
  "Now calling" faint
  if waiting = 0
    "Nobody waiting" head
  else
    each token today where seen = no sort at top 1 as t
      t.name huge
  waiting "waiting" faint
  button "Call next" fill accent tap set all token.seen = yes where id = first(token today where seen = no sort at).id
"Tokens today" head
each token today sort at as t empty "No tokens yet today."
  row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
    "#" index + 1 bold
    t.name grow
    if t.seen
      "Seen" color good
    else
      "Waiting" color warn
