table check what pick Tyres|Oil|Lights|Washer|Interior = Tyres
statcard count(check week), "of 5 checks done this week", 5
if count(check week) = 5
  "All five done. The car is ready." head color good
each options check.what as w
  row card gap 2
    toggle check week where what = w
    w grow
section "Last 6 weeks"
  grid 6 gap 1
    each 0..5 as n
      stack gap 0 align center
        count(check week of (today - 7 * (5 - n))) small bold
        box height 14 radius 4 fill accent opacity clamp(count(check week of (today - 7 * (5 - n))) / 5, 0.15, 1)

let ceil0(x num) = floor(x) + if(x > floor(x), 1, 0)
table fam name text, members num 1..20 = 2
setting gift money = 0 "Gift total"
let heads = sum(fam.members)
let share(f fam) = if(heads > 0, ceil0(gift * f.members / heads / 100) * 100, 0)
topbar fam, "Log family"
row gap 2
  statcard gift, "gift total"
  statcard heads, "people chipping in"
section "Each family pays", "rounded up to 100"
  each fam as f empty "Add each family with how many people are in it."
    row tap edit f swipe remove f
      f.name grow
      f.members "people" faint
      share(f) bold
"Collected" sum(fam, share(it)) "so" sum(fam, share(it)) - gift "extra for the card or flowers" faint

app "Waste Watch" apple mint
table veggie name text
table stockin veggie ref veggie, kg num 1..1000
table stockout veggie ref veggie, kg num 0.5..1000, how pick Sold|Wasted = Sold
each veggie sort name as v
  let wasted = sum(v.stockout.kg where how = Wasted)
  let pct = wasted * 100 / max(sum(v.stockin.kg), 1)
  row card tap edit v
    v.name bold grow
    round(pct) "% waste" color if(pct > 10, bad, ink)
bars veggie, sum(it.stockout.kg where how = Wasted), it.name

app "Chess Club" game ink
table player name text
table game p1 ref player, p2 ref player, result pick First_won|Draw|Second_won = Draw, moves num 5..200 = 40 "Moves played"
setting rounds num = 10 "Games each player should play"
let pts(p player) = count(game where p1 = p and result = First_won) + count(game where p2 = p and result = Second_won) + count(game where (p1 = p or p2 = p) and result = Draw) / 2
let played(p player) = count(game where p1 = p or p2 = p)
"Chess Club" head
statcard count(game), "games played by" plural(count(player), "player"), count(player) * rounds / 2
section "Standings", "points: win 1, draw half"
  each player sort pts(it) desc as p empty "No players yet. Add the members below."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      text index + 1 bold
      p.name bold grow
      played(p) "games" faint
      pts(p) big
section "Points", "top 5"
  bars player sort pts(it) desc top 5, pts(it), it.name
section "Games per week", "last 4 weeks"
  bars days last 4 weeks, count(game week of it), monthday(it)
section "Results", "all games"
  share game by result, count(it), it.key
section "Latest games"
  each game top 5 as g empty "No games yet. Record the first result."
    row gap 2
      g.p1.name bold grow
      "vs" faint
      g.p2.name bold grow
      g.result faint
form player, "Add player"
form game, "Record game"
section "Games played", "per player"
  each player sort name as p
    row gap 2
      p.name bold grow
      played(p) "of" rounds faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(played(p) / max(rounds, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Draw rate"
  goal count(game where result = Draw), max(count(game), 1), "games drawn", "draws"

user_text:
Edit request: "kind" should really be group, that would be great

Current program:
app "Ride Profit" bike ink dark
table ride platform pick Bykea|Careem|Indrive|Cash = Cash, fare money, km num 1..100 = 8 unit "km", tip money = 0
table expense kind pick Fuel|Repair|Phone|Food = Fuel, amount money
setting target money = 35000 "Weekly profit goal"
let income = sum(ride.fare week) + sum(ride.tip week)
let profit = income - sum(expense.amount week)
topbar ride, "Add ride"
statcard profit, "profit this week of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat income, "earned"
  stat sum(expense.amount week), "spent"
  stat round(profit / max(sum(ride.km week), 1)), "profit per km"
section "Profit", "last 7 days"
  goalbars last 7 days, sum(ride.fare on it) + sum(ride.tip on it) - sum(expense.amount on it), target / 7
section "Platforms", "this week"
  share ride week by platform, sum(it.fare), it.key
section "Rides per platform"
  each options ride.platform as p
    row gap 2
      p bold grow
      count(ride week where platform = p) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(ride week where platform = p) / max(count(ride week), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Spending", "this month"
  share expense month by kind, sum(it.amount), it.key
section "Add an expense"
  form expense, "Save expense"
section "Today's rides", plural(count(ride today), "ride")
  each ride today as r empty "No rides yet today. Log the first fare."
    row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
      stack grow gap 0
        r.platform bold
        r.km "km" faint
      r.fare + r.tip bold
if profit >= target
  "Weekly goal reached." color good bold
section "Latest entries", "tap one to edit it"
  each ride top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.platform bold
        x.km "km" faint
      x.fare bold

request: slot Orange between Silver and Gold
program_before:
app "Zakat check" coin ocean
table paid amount money, note text?
state cash money = 0
state bank money = 0
state gold num = 0
state owed money = 0
state gold_rate money = 0
state silver_rate money = 0
state basis pick Silver|Gold = Silver
let wealth = cash + bank + gold * gold_rate - owed
let nisab = if(basis = Silver, 612.36 * silver_rate, 87.48 * gold_rate)
let due = if(nisab > 0 and wealth >= nisab, wealth * 0.025, 0)
row bar
  "Zakat check" head grow
section "What you hold"
  field cash "Cash in hand"
  field bank "Bank and savings"
  field gold "Gold (grams)"
  field owed "Debts due now"
section "Today's rates", "per gram"
  field gold_rate "Gold"
  field silver_rate "Silver"
  row gap 1
    "Nisab by" faint
    choice basis
if nisab = 0
  "Type today's gold or silver rate to see the nisab." faint
else
  statcard round(due), if(wealth >= nisab, "zakat due at 2.5%", "below nisab, no zakat due")
  goal max(wealth, 0), nisab, "net wealth against nisab"
  button "Mark as paid" tap add paid amount = round(due), note = "Zakat"
section "Paid so far", sum(paid.amount)
  list paid top 6, "Nothing recorded yet."

table mark subject pick Maths|English|Science|Urdu|Islamiat|Computer = Maths, test text, score num 0..200, total num 1..200 = 100

section "Best and weakest"
  "Best score" max(mark, it.score * 100 / it.total) "%" bold
  "Lowest score" min(mark, it.score * 100 / it.total) "%" faint

    row card gap 2 tap edit m swipe remove m
      stack grow gap 0
        m.test bold
        m.subject faint
      m.score "/" m.total bold

  statcard count(mark week), "entries this week"

  "The academy is full." color warn bold

program_before:
app "Bug Board" tool purple dark
table bug title text, severity pick Low|Medium|High|Critical = Medium, status pick Open|Fixing|Done = Open, hours num 1..40 = 2 unit "h"
setting budget num = 60 "Sprint hours budget"
state tab pick Open|Fixing|Done = Open
let critical = count(bug where severity = Critical and status != Done)
topbar bug, "Report bug"
statcard critical, "critical bugs still open", count(bug where severity = Critical)
goal sum(bug.hours where status = Done), budget, "hours fixed this sprint", "h"
row gap 1
  each options bug.status as s
    button s count(bug where status = s) fill if(tab = s, accent, soft) grow tap set tab = s
each bug where status = tab sort hours desc as b empty "No bugs in this column. Nice and quiet."
  row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
    stack grow gap 0
      b.title bold
      b.severity "-" b.hours "h" faint color if(b.severity = Critical, bad, muted)
    if b.status = Open
      button "Start" tap set b.status = Fixing
    if b.status = Fixing
      button "Done" tap set b.status = Done
section "By severity", "all bugs"
  share bug by severity, count(it), it.key
section "Bugs reported per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(bug on it)
section "Hours by status", "all bugs"
  share bug by status, sum(it.hours), it.key
section "Hours still to fix", "open and fixing"
  row gap 2
    stat sum(bug.hours where status = Open), "h open"
    stat sum(bug.hours where status = Fixing), "h in progress"
    stat budget - sum(bug.hours where status = Done), "h of budget left"
if sum(bug.hours where status != Done) > budget
  "Open work is more than the sprint budget. Cut scope." color warn bold
section "Done", count(bug where status = Done)
  list bug where status = Done top 5, "Nothing fixed yet. Pick a bug and press Start."
section "Hours per severity", "all bugs"
  each options bug.severity as v
    row gap 2

table paid tenant ref tenant, amount money
table repair what text, cost money
setting due_day num = 5 "Rent due on day"
let expected = sum(tenant.rent)
let received = sum(paid.amount month)
topbar tenant, "Add tenant"
statcard received, "received of" expected, expected
if monthday(today) > due_day and received < expected
  "Rent is late for" count(tenant, count(it.paid month) = 0) "tenants." color bad bold
section "Tenants", "tick when the rent arrives"
  each tenant sort flat as t empty "No tenants yet. Add the first flat with Add tenant."
    row card gap 2 tap edit t swipe remove t
      toggle t.paid month
      stack grow gap 0
        t.name bold
        "Flat" t.flat faint
      t.rent bold
section "Rent per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(paid.amount month of it), monthname(it)
section "Money in and out", "this month"
  row gap 2
    stat received, "rent in"
    stat sum(repair.cost month), "repairs"
    stat received - sum(repair.cost month), "kept"
section "Repairs"
  list repair top 4, "No repairs this month."
  form repair, "Add repair"
section "Rent by flat", "monthly"
  share tenant, it.rent, it.flat
section "Collected so far", "this month"
  goal received, max(expected, 1), "of the expected rent"
section "Biggest rents", "top 3"
  each tenant sort rent desc top 3 as t
    row gap 2
      t.name bold grow
      t.rent faint
section "Latest entries", "tap one to edit it"
  each tenant top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        "Flat" x.flat faint
      x.rent bold

table reading sys num 70..250 unit "mmHg", dia num 40..150 unit "mmHg", pulse num? 30..200, moment pick Morning|Evening|Other = Morning
setting limit_sys num = 130 "Upper limit (systolic)"
setting limit_dia num = 85 "Upper limit (diastolic)"
let high = count(reading month where sys > limit_sys or dia > limit_dia)
let n = count(reading month)
remind "Measure your blood pressure" at 8:00, 20:00
topbar reading, "Add reading"
row card gap 3 align center
  stack grow gap 0
    "Latest reading" faint
    join(last(reading.sys), "/", last(reading.dia)) huge
    if(last(reading.sys) > limit_sys or last(reading.dia) > limit_dia, "Above your limit. Rest and measure again.", "Inside your limits") faint
    "Pulse" last(reading.pulse) faint
  icon heart
section "Systolic trend", "last 30 days"
  trend reading last 30 days, it.sys
  "Your limit is" limit_sys faint
section "Diastolic trend", "last 30 days"
  trend reading last 30 days, it.dia
row gap 2
  statcard round(avg(reading.sys month)), "average systolic this month"
  statcard round(avg(reading.dia month)), "average diastolic this month"
  statcard high, "high readings of" n "this month", n
section "Morning or evening", "average systolic"
  each options reading.moment as m
    row gap 1
      m grow
      round(avg(reading.sys where moment = m)) bold
      "from" count(reading where moment = m) "readings" faint
section "Readings per week"
  daybars last 14 days, count(reading on it)
section "Highest reading", "this month"
  max(reading.sys month) "/" max(reading.dia month) big
  "Lowest" min(reading.sys month) "/" min(reading.dia month) faint
section "History"
  list reading by day, "No readings yet. Measure sitting down, after five minutes of rest."
section "Pulse", "when recorded"
  trend reading last 30 days, it.pulse
  "Average pulse" round(avg(reading.pulse month)) faint
section "In range", "this month"
  goal n - high, max(n, 1), "readings inside your limits", ""

  "Readings this year" count(reading year) faint

Current program:
app "Guest House" home ocean
table room name text, rate money
table stay room ref room, guest text, nights num 1..30 = 1, checkin date = today, paid bool
setting target num = 70 "Occupancy target (percent)"
let occupied(r room) = count(stay where room = r and checkin <= today and checkin + nights > today)
let busy = count(room, occupied(it) > 0)
topbar room, "Add room"
goal busy, max(count(room), 1), "rooms occupied tonight", "rooms"
row gap 2
  stat round(busy * 100 / max(count(room), 1)), "percent occupied, target" target
  stat sum(stay where paid = no, it.nights * it.room.rate), "unpaid stays"
  stat count(stay where checkin = today), "arrivals today"
section "Rooms tonight"
  grid 2 gap 1
    each room sort name as r empty "No rooms yet. Add your rooms with Add room."
      stack radius 10 pad 1 gap 0 fill if(occupied(r) > 0, accent, soft) tap edit r
        r.name bold color if(occupied(r) > 0, bg, ink)
        if(occupied(r) > 0, "Occupied", "Free") faint color if(occupied(r) > 0, bg, muted)
section "Check in a guest"
  form stay, "Check in"
section "Arriving soon", "next stays"
  each stay where checkin >= today sort checkin top 4 as s empty "No arrivals coming."
    row card gap 2 tap edit s swipe remove s
      toggle s.paid
      stack grow gap 0
        s.guest bold
        s.room.name "-" s.nights "nights" faint
      s.checkin faint
section "Income", "last 4 weeks"
  bars days last 4 weeks, sum(stay week of it, it.nights * it.room.rate), monthday(it)
section "Nights by room", "this month"
  share stay month by room.name, sum(it.nights), it.key
section "Recent", "tap one to edit it"
  each room top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."
    row card gap 2 tap edit x swipe remove x
      stack grow gap 0
        x.name bold
        "Rate per night" faint
      x.rate bold

program_before:
app "Chess" board slate dark
table game opponent text, side pick White|Black = White, result pick Win|Draw|Loss = Win, moves num 5..200 = 35
setting rating num = 1200 "My rating"
state show pick All|Win|Draw|Loss = All
let wins = count(game where result = Win)
let played = count(game)
topbar game, "Log a game"
row gap 2
  statcard rating, "my rating"
  statcard round(wins * 100 / max(played, 1)), "% win rate", 100
  statcard played, "games played"
section "Results", "all games"
  share game by result, count(it), it.key
section "As white or black", "wins"
  each options game.side as s
    row gap 1
      s grow
      count(game where side = s and result = Win) "wins of" count(game where side = s) bold
section "Games per week", "last 8 weeks"
  bars 1..8, count(game week of (today - 7 * (8 - it))), join("W", it)
section "Short games", "under 20 moves"
  count(game where moves < 20) big
  "Average length" round(avg(game.moves)) "moves" faint
row gap 1
  button "All" fill if(show = All, accent, soft) tap set show = All
  each options game.result as r
    button r fill if(show = r, accent, soft) tap set show = r
each game where show = All or result = show as g empty "No games here. Log the next one after you play."
  row card gap 2 tap edit g swipe remove g
    stack grow gap 0
      "vs" g.opponent bold
      g.side g.moves "moves" faint
    g.result bold color if(g.result = Win, good, if(g.result = Loss, bad, ink))
row gap 2
  statcard count(game week), "entries this week"
  statcard count(game prev week), "entries last week"
section "Totals", "all time"
  count(game) "entries so far" big
  "This year" count(game year) faint
  "Last one" since(game) "days ago" faint
section "Which weekdays", "all time"
  bars ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"], count(game where dayname(at) = it), it
section "Busy days", "last 5 weeks"
  daygrid last 35 days, count(game on it), 2

table project client text, item pick Door|Bed|Cupboard|Table|Chair = Door, price money, advance money = 0, stage pick Quote|Cutting|Assembly|Polish|Delivered = Quote, due date
table material details text was what, cost money
setting slots num = 6 "Jobs the workshop can hold"
let open = count(project where stage != Delivered)
let balance = sum(project where stage != Delivered, it.price - it.advance)
topbar project, "New job"
goal open, slots, "jobs in the workshop", "jobs"
row gap 2
  stat balance, "to collect from clients"
  stat sum(material.cost month), "wood and fittings this month"
  stat sum(project.price month where stage = Delivered), "delivered this month"
scroll gap 1
  each options project.stage as s
    stack card gap 0 width 120
      s bold
      count(project where stage = s) big
      sum(project.price where stage = s) faint
section "Open jobs", "soonest due first"
  each project where stage != Delivered sort due as p empty "No open jobs. Quote the next customer."
    row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
      stack grow gap 0
        p.client p.item bold
        p.stage "- due" p.due faint color if(p.due < today, bad, muted)
      stack gap 0 align end
        p.price - p.advance bold
        "balance" tiny faint
section "Jobs by item", "all time"
  share project by item, count(it), it.key
section "Materials", "latest"
  list material top 4, "No materials bought yet."
  form material, "Add material"
section "Income per week", "last 4 weeks"
  bars days last 4 weeks, sum(project.price week of it where stage = Delivered), monthday(it)
section "Open jobs per item", "not delivered"
  each options project.item as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(project where item = v and stage != Delivered) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(project where item = v and stage != Delivered) / max(open, 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if count(project where stage != Delivered and due < today) > 0
  "A job is past its due date. Call the client." color bad bold

app "Fleet Care" car slate
table vehicle plate text, kind pick Truck|Van|Pickup|Bike = Truck
table service vehicle ref vehicle, work pick Oil|Tyres|Brakes|Engine|Inspection = Oil, cost money, km num 0..900000
setting interval num = 90 "Service every (days)"
let due = count(vehicle, due(it.service, interval))
topbar vehicle, "Add vehicle"
row gap 2
  stat count(vehicle), "vehicles"
  stat due, "due for service"
  stat sum(service.cost month), "spent this month"
section "Vehicles", "oldest service first"
  each vehicle sort since(it.service) desc as v empty "No vehicles yet. Add your first truck or van."
    row card gap 2 tap edit v swipe remove v
      stack grow gap 0
        v.plate bold
        v.kind "- last service" since(v.service) "days ago" faint color if(due(v.service, interval), bad, muted)
      sum(v.service.cost) bold
section "Cost per vehicle", "all time"
  bars vehicle, sum(it.service.cost), it.plate
section "Spend per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(service.cost month of it), monthname(it)
section "Work done", "by type"
  share service by work, count(it), it.key
section "Log a service"
  form service, "Save service"
list service top 5, "No services logged yet."
section "Vehicles per kind", "fleet size"
  each options vehicle.kind as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(vehicle where kind = v) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(vehicle where kind = v) / max(count(vehicle), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
section "Due now"
  each vehicle where due(service, interval) as v empty "No vehicle is due. Everything is serviced."
    row gap 2
      v.plate bold grow
      "Due" color bad

  each vehicle top 3 as x empty "Nothing here yet."

        x.plate bold
        x.kind faint
      sum(x.service.cost) bold

  stat count(goat where status = Sick), "sick"

        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(goat where status = s) / max(count(goat), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2

request: Relabel amount as total without losing data
program_before:
app "Club Dues" users red
table member name text, group pick Juniors|Seniors|Veterans = Seniors
table payment member ref member, amount money = 2000
setting target money = 60000 "Monthly dues target"
let paid = count(member, count(it.payment month) > 0)
topbar member, "Add member"
statcard sum(payment.amount month), "collected of" target, target
row gap 2
  stat paid, "members paid"
  stat count(member) - paid, "still to pay"
  stat round(paid * 100 / max(count(member), 1)), "percent paid"
section "Members", "tick when paid"
  each member sort name as m empty "No members yet. Add the first player with Add member."
    row card gap 2 tap edit m swipe remove m
      toggle m.payment month
      stack grow gap 0
        m.name bold
        m.group faint
      if count(m.payment month) = 0
        "Due" faint color bad
section "Collected per month", "last 6 months"
  bars days last 6 months, sum(payment.amount month of it), monthname(it)
section "By group", "this month"
  share member by group, count(it), it.key
section "Paid so far", "this month"
  goal sum(payment.amount month), target, "of the monthly target"
section "Last payments", "newest first"
  each payment top 5 as p empty "No payments yet this month."
    row gap 2
      p.member.name bold grow
      p.at faint
      p.amount bold
section "Members by group"
  row gap 2
    each options member.group as g
      stat count(member where group = g), g
section "Paid per group", "this month"
  each options member.group as v
    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(member where group = v and count(payment month) > 0) faint
      draw 100, 4 width 80
        rect 0, 0, 100, 4 fill soft radius 2
        rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(count(member where group = v and count(payment month) > 0) / max(count(member where group = v), 1), 0, 1), 4 fill accent radius 2
if count(member) - paid > 5
  "Many members are behind. Call them this week." color warn bold

app "Mandi Trades" paw grey
table trade animal pick Cow|Buffalo|Goat|Calf|Bull = Goat, weight num 20..900 = 100 unit "kg", bought money, sold money = 0, status pick Holding|Sold = Holding

        t.weight "kg, bought for" t.bought faint

section "Deals per day", "last 14 days"
  daybars last 14 days, count(trade on it)
section "Weight bought", "last 7 days"
  trend days last 7 days, sum(trade.weight on it)

  stat sum(feedcost.amount month), "spent so far"
  each feedcost top 3 as f empty "No feed costs yet. Add one below."
    row gap 2
      f.animal bold grow
      f.amount faint
form feedcost, "Add feed cost"
section "Sold", count(trade where status = Sold)
  list trade where status = Sold top 6, "No animals sold yet."
if profit >= target
  "Monthly goal reached." color good bold

    row gap 2
      v bold grow
      count(trade where animal = v and status = Holding) faint

        else
          "Full" color bad bold
      draw 100, 4

    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold

form cleaner

program_before:
app "Overtime" money green
setting rate money = 500 "Hourly rate"
setting normal num = 48 "Normal hours per week"
state worked num = 54
state mult pick Time_and_half|Double = Time_and_half
let ot = max(worked - normal, 0)
let reg = min(worked, normal)
let m = if(mult = Double, 2, 1.5)
let regpay = reg * rate
let otpay = ot * rate * m
section "This week"
  field worked "Hours worked"
  field rate
  field normal
  choice mult
if worked = 0
  "Enter the hours you worked to see your pay." faint
else
  statcard regpay + otpay, "total pay this week", 0
  section "Breakdown"
    "Normal:" reg "h =" regpay bold
    "Overtime:" ot "h at x" m "=" otpay bold
    "Overtime is" round(otpay / (regpay + otpay) * 100) "% of your pay" faint
